criteria.behavior: Dwell is off on fresh/invalid preferences and enabled only through explicit opt-in with the required delay/look-away behavior.
criteria.check: Run scripts/verification-lane.sh p11 after M0 adds it; inspect DwellClick source, preference migration and default-policy-review.md.
criteria.expected: Fresh, absent and malformed preferences cannot cause dwell input; explicit off persists. Opt-in uses >=1s plus look-away and respects voice/ask/pick suppression.

criteria.behavior: Every decider receives a fresh resolved target hint and selection remains separate from looking.
criteria.check: Run p11 target/cancel/staleness cases; inspect Jev/Terra-recovery/Browser/coordinator wiring and .agent/results/P11/integration.json.
criteria.expected: No raw gaze-coordinate authority, gaze-only default action or stale/wrong-subject hint. Face/window/display changes invalidate the old target.

criteria.behavior: Target feedback and overlay geometry support accurate selection and voice-only alternatives.
criteria.check: Inspect real overlay/selection evidence and p11 ambiguous/small-target/no-gaze cases.
criteria.expected: Jev-owned targets follow >=60pt/about 2.5-degree guidance, tiny host controls have disambiguation, and supported workflows remain usable without gaze.

criteria.behavior: Adaptive sampling, bounded resources and tracker smoke preserve active tracking and recovery.
criteria.check: Run the planned p11-live mode under the desktop lock after authorization; inspect qualification.json, smoke output and combined-runtime resource series.
criteria.expected: Active >=15fps, wake <=5s, steady RSS <=2.5GB and idle CPU <=10%; actual backend and configuration reported. No hidden feature disablement or RSS/footprint substitution.

criteria.behavior: The real-camera physical gaze population meets strict success and recovery requirements.
criteria.check: Inspect frozen population, actual G6 attempts, independent selected-target/outcome evidence, raw rows and candidate/runtime hashes.
criteria.expected: >=95% strict gaze success with PROGRAM statistics; zero unintended input and false Done. Synthetic coordinates/fixtures do not count as physical success.

criteria.behavior: Independent review and coordinated eyes/agent handoff support complete phase acceptance.
criteria.check: Inspect source/final judge verdicts, serialized integration checks, evidence bindings and P11 handoff.
criteria.expected: Authorized PASS with no unresolved finding; M0 default correction alone is not full P11 acceptance. Previous runtime remains recoverable.
